halaman.script: Faceless 3D animated style. Every person has a completely smooth blank skin-colored face with no eyes, no nose, no mouth. A cozy, modest Indonesian family kitchen and dining room early in the morning: a gas stove with one pot on the right, a wooden dining table with four chairs in the center, cream walls, a window on the left with soft sunrise light Ummi, a grown adult 160 cm tall, same outfit as the reference photo, the first reference photo. Ummi stands at the gas stove facing the pot at a slight three-quarter angle toward the camera, holding a wooden spoon in her right hand over the pot. Ummi stirs the soup in the pot slowly three times with the wooden spoon in her right hand. Camera beside the stove at chest height, medium shot, head upright.

Faceless 3D animated style. Every person has a completely smooth blank skin-colored face with no eyes, no nose, no mouth. Same room as the previous page. Ummi, a grown adult 160 cm tall, same outfit as the reference photo, the first reference photo. Ummi stands at the stove holding one white bowl of soup with both hands. Ummi walks forward from the stove to the dining table with the white bowl of soup in both hands. Then she places the bowl on the table and lets go. Camera beside the stove at chest height, medium shot, head upright.

Faceless 3D animated style. Every person has a completely smooth blank skin-colored face with no eyes, no nose, no mouth. Same room as the previous page. Ummi, a grown adult 160 cm tall, same outfit as the reference photo, the first reference photo. Ummi sits on a wooden chair at the dining table facing the camera at a slight three-quarter angle, the white bowl of soup on the table in front of her. Ummi rests her right hand on her lower back and lets her shoulders drop slowly. Camera in front of the dining table at eye level, medium shot, head upright.

Faceless 3D animated style. Every person has a completely smooth blank skin-colored face with no eyes, no nose, no mouth. Same room as the previous page. Uwais, a small 15-year-old child 160 cm tall, same outfit as the reference photo, the matching reference photo; Saheela, a small 7-year-old child 115 cm tall, same outfit as the reference photo, the matching reference photo. Uwais stands on the left and Saheela on the right, side by side in the doorway of the dining room with their backs to the camera, Saheela clearly smaller; the dining table is ahead of them. Uwais and Saheela walk forward at a normal pace to the dining table and stop beside it. Only after they stop, Saheela tilts her head to the side. Camera behind Uwais and Saheela at shoulder height, medium-wide shot, head upright.

Faceless 3D animated style. Every person has a completely smooth blank skin-colored face with no eyes, no nose, no mouth. Same room as the previous page. Ummi, a grown adult 160 cm tall, same outfit as the reference photo, the first reference photo; Uwais, a small 15-year-old child 160 cm tall, same outfit as the reference photo, the matching reference photo. Ummi sits at the dining table; Uwais stands beside her holding a glass of water in his right hand; both face the camera at a slight three-quarter angle. Uwais places the glass of water on the table in front of Ummi with his right hand. Camera in front of the dining table at eye level, medium shot, head upright.

balon.teks: Ummi istirahat, ya. Nanti Uwais yang cuci piring.
